question: In December, she will have _______ working at this academic institution for twenty years.
explanation: Rumus Future Perfect Continuous adalah will have + been + Verb-ing (working) untuk menyatakan durasi hingga titik masa depan.
translation: Pada bulan Desember nanti, dia akan telah bekerja di institusi akademik ini selama dua puluh tahun.
targetSentence: In December, she will have been working at this academic institution for twenty years.
indonesianPrompt: Pada bulan Desember nanti, dia akan telah bekerja di institusi akademik ini selama dua puluh tahun.
acceptedAnswers: In December, she will have been working at this academic institution for twenty years.

question: By midnight, the marathon runners will have been _______ for more than eight consecutive hours.
explanation: Setelah 'will have been', kata kerja wajib berakhiran -ing: running.
translation: Menjelang tengah malam, para pelari maraton akan telah berlari selama lebih dari delapan jam berturut-turut.
targetSentence: By midnight, the marathon runners will have been running for more than eight consecutive hours.
indonesianPrompt: Menjelang tengah malam, para pelari maraton akan telah berlari selama lebih dari delapan jam berturut-turut.
acceptedAnswers: By midnight, the marathon runners will have been running for more than eight consecutive hours.

question: By the time he turns thirty, he _______ have been studying medical science for a decade.
explanation: Rumus utama Future Perfect Continuous diawali dengan modal 'will' + have been + Verb-ing.
translation: Saat dia menginjak usia tiga puluh tahun, dia akan telah mempelajari ilmu kedokteran selama satu dekade.
targetSentence: By the time he turns thirty, he will have been studying medical science for a decade.
indonesianPrompt: Saat dia menginjak usia tiga puluh tahun, dia akan telah mempelajari ilmu kedokteran selama satu dekade.
acceptedAnswers: By the time he turns thirty, he will have been studying medical science for a decade.

question: If you practice your irregular verbs consistently, you _______ master English much faster.
explanation: Pada kalimat pengandaian Tipe 1 (First Conditional), klausa utama menggunakan Simple Future (will + Verb 1).
translation: Jika kamu melatih kata kerja tak beraturanmu secara konsisten, kamu akan menguasai bahasa Inggris jauh lebih cepat.
targetSentence: If you practice your irregular verbs consistently, you will master English much faster.
indonesianPrompt: Jika kamu melatih kata kerja tak beraturanmu secara konsisten, kamu akan menguasai bahasa Inggris jauh lebih cepat.
acceptedAnswers: If you practice your irregular verbs consistently, you will master English much faster.

question: By the end of next month, we will have been _______ in this modern apartment for two years.
explanation: Menggabungkan batas waktu masa depan dan durasi 'for two years' menggunakan 'will have been living'.
translation: Menjelang akhir bulan depan, kami akan telah tinggal di apartemen modern ini selama dua tahun.
targetSentence: By the end of next month, we will have been living in this modern apartment for two years.
